products.name: Intune Win32 Application Packaging & Deployment — Commercial
products.short_description: The repeatable way to package and deploy Windows apps through Intune — build the .intunewin, author correct detection/requirement rules, model dependencies and supersedence, and assign in rings. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Package and deploy any Windows app through Intune — reliably, with detection that actually works

Getting a Windows application onto your fleet shouldn't be a coin flip. Done by hand, app deployments fail silently: the installer runs but Intune reports the wrong state, detection rules are guesses, dependencies install out of order, and a bad package lands on everyone at once. This solution gives you the repeatable Win32 packaging method — build the .intunewin, write detection and requirement rules that are correct, model dependencies and supersedence, and assign in rings so a bad build never reaches production.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Win32 (.intunewin) app model, how the Intune Management Extension installs and reports, detection vs. requirement rules, dependencies, supersedence, and the ring-based assignment model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, the Win32 Content Prep Tool, install/uninstall command lines, a reliable detection method, requirement rules, source/distribution hygiene) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: prepare source and capture the .intunewin, create the Win32 app, set install/uninstall commands, author detection and requirement rules, model dependencies and supersedence, assign in pilot/broad rings, then validate and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — a packaging/wrapper helper, install-detection validation, a deployment success/failure report across the fleet, safe remediation of failed installs, and a target-ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Windows applications that deploy predictably from Intune — correct detection, ordered dependencies, supersedence handled, and ring assignment so a bad package never reaches production — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WIN32-New-IntuneWinPackage.ps1 — wrap an app source folder into a .intunewin package
    • WIN32-Remediation.ps1 — safely remediate a failed Win32 app install on a device
    • WIN32-Report.ps1 — fleet-wide Win32 app deployment success/failure report (Microsoft Graph)
    • WIN32-Set-RingTargeting.ps1 — build the pilot/broad ring groups for Win32 app rollout
    • WIN32-Validation.ps1 — validate a Win32 app install + detection rule on a device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
